_comment: GitHub Copilot hooks — local policy/observability gates.
DOCS: https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/reference/hooks-reference
https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/concepts/agents/hooks
Fourteen events are supported (this file wires the ones that earn their
keep; the rest are listed so you know what is available):
LIFECYCLE
sessionStart          — new or resumed session begins   → additionalContext
sessionEnd            — session terminates              → notification only
agentStop             — main agent finishes a turn      → decision: block|allow
subagentStart         — a subagent is spawned           → additionalContext
subagentStop          — a subagent completes            → decision: block|allow
PROMPT
userPromptSubmitted   — user sends a message            → modifiedPrompt (SDK only)
userPromptTransformed — runtime rewrote the prompt      → modifiedTransformedPrompt
TOOLS
preToolUse            — before any tool/MCP call        → permissionDecision, modifiedArgs
postToolUse           — after a tool returns            → modifiedResult, additionalContext
postToolUseFailure    — after a tool fails              → additionalContext (recovery hints)
permissionRequest     — before the permission service   → behavior: allow|deny
CONTEXT & DIAGNOSTICS
preCompact            — context compaction begins       → notification only
errorOccurred         — agent or tool errored           → notification only
notification          — CLI emitted a notification      → additionalContext (async)
HOOK TYPES: `command` (bash / powershell / cross-platform command),
`http` (HTTPS POST of the payload), and `prompt` (auto-submitted text,
sessionStart + CLI only).
DECISIONS: preToolUse hooks emit JSON on stdout rather than relying on exit
codes — {"permissionDecision": "allow"|"deny"|"ask"}. See scripts/policy-gate.sh.
FAILURE MODES: timeouts always fail OPEN. preToolUse command hooks fail
CLOSED on non-timeout errors; HTTP hooks fail open. Output is capped at
10 MiB per invocation.
CLOUD AGENT: runs in an ephemeral Linux sandbox — only `bash` and `command`
are honoured, a subset of events fire, and there is no user interactivity,
so `ask` behaves as `deny` there. Keep gates advisory or fail-open.
SCOPE: repo hooks live in .github/hooks/*.json; personal hooks in
~/.copilot/hooks/*.json. Set chat.useCustomAgentHooks: true in VS Code to
additionally honour agent-scoped hooks declared in .agent.md frontmatter.

preToolUse._comment: Scoped by matcher to shell/edit tools — running the policy scan before every read is wasted latency. Emits a permissionDecision object; see scripts/policy-gate.sh.

postToolUseFailure._comment: Records failures separately from successes so the observation log can distinguish 'agent tried and failed' from 'agent never tried'.

preCompact._comment: Compaction is where context silently disappears. Logging it makes 'the agent forgot X' debuggable after the fact.
